(@) Store the eluted DNA at 4 °C for short-term use or at −20 °C for long-term storage.

::: {.callout-tip title="PAUSE POINT"}
Eluted DNA can be stored at 4 °C (short term) or −20 °C (long term) before quality assessment and downstream use.
:::

(@) Assess DNA purity by spectrophotometry (e.g. NanoDrop; A~260~/A~280~ and A~260~/A~230~ ratios) and quantify DNA concentration by fluorometry (e.g. Qubit), following EnGeL-MOLB-NAQC. Record values in the database and the lab book.
